assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: premium website hero photograph for a Chinese emotional companion research project, landscape 16:9 wide frame. The companion is an original understated rounded pebble-like plush, warm ivory dense short pile wool, two very small rounded ears, two tiny dark espresso inset eyes, no mouth, no screen, no buttons, no branding, about 22cm tall, with a simple gentle silhouette and a subtly weighted base. Product sits on the RIGHT side at around 70% image width, fully visible, turned a little toward the viewer. Desk extends across the lower half. LEFT half is very clean pale warm-grey plaster wall and mostly empty desk, intentional broad quiet negative space for dark typographic overlay, never place any typography in image. Slatted afternoon daylight from upper right creates believable soft diagonal shadow and luminous fur texture. Right edge a soft sheer linen curtain, a slightly out-of-focus muted olive wall background. One closed thin cream notebook near the far right, no other props, no plants, no people. The whole frame feels like a contemporary industrial design studio editorial shot, human, tactile, restrained, expensive, inviting. Natural warm-neutral whites rather than yellow wash. Medium-format photography, detailed natural fibers, physical believable shadows, subtle depth, artistic asymmetrical composition, balanced highlights, no harsh bloom, no vignette, no borders, no graphic overlays, no text, no logos, no watermark. This is a concept visual, not a depiction of an existing commercial product.
